items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: But later we had Clayton Doerr, what he called Sunshine, played guitar.

ctx.x: I'm wondering about that now. Sharpie had a guitar player named Bill Bourgeois or something.
No, no, it was me, Bill Bourgeois. But later we had Clayton Doerr, what he called Sunshine, played guitar. He had real thick glasses, close, near-sighted.
